```html
    <header>
        <h1>🎮 EVOLVED GAMES LIBRARY</h1>
        <div class="stats">
            <div class="stat">
                <div class="stat-value" id="total-games">0</div>
                <div class="stat-label">Total Games</div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat">
                <div class="stat-value" id="playable-games">0</div>
                <div class="stat-label">Web Playable</div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat">
                <div class="stat-value" id="max-gen">0</div>
                <div class="stat-label">Max Generation</div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </header>
    
    <div class="filters">
        <button class="filter-btn active" onclick="filterGames('all')">All Games</button>
        <button class="filter-btn" onclick="filterGames('playable')">Web Playable Only</button>
        <button class="filter-btn" onclick="filterGames('python')">Python Only</button>
        <button class="filter-btn" onclick="filterGames('high-gen')">High Generation (>30)</button>
    </div>
    
    <div class="games-grid" id="games-container"></div>
    
    <script>
        let allGames = [];
        let currentFilter = 'all';
        
        async function loadGames() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch('/api/game_engine', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({action: 'list'})
                });
                
                const data = await response.json();
                
                if (data.success) {
                    const lines = data.data.output.split('\n');
                    allGames = [];
                    
                    for (const line of lines) {
                        const match = line.match(/• (.+\.py)/);
                        if (match) {
                            const name = match[1];
                            const genMatch = name.match(/gen(\d+)/);
                            const gen = genMatch ? parseInt(genMatch[1]) : 0;
                            
                            // Check if HTML version exists
                            const htmlName = name.replace('.py', '.html');
                            const htmlExists = await checkFileExists(`/static/games/${htmlName}`);
                            
                            allGames.push({
                                name: name,
                                generation: gen,
                                playable: htmlExists,
                                htmlName: htmlName
                            });
                        }
                    }
                    
                    updateStats();
                    renderGames();
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('Failed to load games:', e);
                document.getElementById('games-container').innerHTML = 
                    '<div style="padding: 40px; text-align: center; color: #ff0000;">Failed to load games</div>';
            }
        }
        
        async function checkFileExists(url) {
            try {
                const response = await fetch(url, { method: 'HEAD' });
                return response.ok;
            } catch {
                return false;
            }
        }
        
        function updateStats() {
            document.getElementById('total-games').textContent = allGames.length;
            document.getElementById('playable-games').textContent = 
                allGames.filter(g => g.playable).length;
            document.getElementById('max-gen').textContent = 
                Math.max(...allGames.map(g => g.generation), 0);
        }
        
        function filterGames(filter) {
            currentFilter = filter;
            
            // Update button states
            document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.classList.remove('active');
            });
            event.target.classList.add('active');
            
            renderGames();
        }
        
        function renderGames() {
            let filtered = [...allGames];
            
            if (currentFilter === 'playable') {
                filtered = filtered.filter(g => g.playable);
            } else if (currentFilter === 'python') {
                filtered = filtered.filter(g => !g.playable);
            } else if (currentFilter === 'high-gen') {
                filtered = filtered.filter(g => g.generation > 30);
            }
            
            // Sort by generation descending
            filtered.sort((a, b) => b.generation - a.generation);
            
            const container = document.getElementById('games-container');
            
            if (filtered.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div style="padding: 40px; text-align: center; grid-column: 1/-1;">No games match filter</div>';
                return;
            }
            
            container.innerHTML = filtered.map(game => `
                <div class="game-card">
                    <div class="game-title">${game.name}</div>
                    <div class="game-meta">
                        <span class="badge badge-gen">Gen ${game.generation}</span>
                        ${game.playable ? '<span class="badge badge-playable">🌐 Playable</span>' : '<span class="badge badge-python">🐍 Python</span>'}
                    </div>
                    <div class="game-actions">
                        <button class="play-btn" 
                                ${!game.playable ? 'disabled' : ''}
                                onclick="playGame('${game.htmlName}')">
                            ${game.playable ? '▶ PLAY' : '❌ Not Converted'}
                        </button>
                        <button class="view-btn" onclick="viewCode('${game.name}')">
                            📄 View Code
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }
        
        function playGame(htmlName) {
            window.open(`/static/games/${htmlName}`, '_blank');
        }
        
        function viewCode(pyName) {
            // Open in new tab - could be enhanced to show inline
            alert('Code viewer coming soon!\\n\\nFile: ' + pyName);
        }
        
        // Load on page load
        loadGames();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```python
        self.harvester = GameHarvester()
        self.generation = 0

        self.max_generated_games = max_generated_games  # Max evolved games
        self.max_gene_pool = max_gene_pool  # Max games in DNA library

        print(f"⏰ Time: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}")
        print("="*70 + "\n")
    
    def harvest_cycle(self):
        """Harvest new games from internet"""
        print("\n🌾 HARVEST CYCLE")
        print("-" * 70)
        
        try:
            count = self.harvester.harvest_batch(count=5)  # 5 games per cycle
            
            if count > 0:
                # Rescan to include new games
                self.engine = AutonomousGameEngine()  # Reload
                print(f"✓ Gene pool expanded: {len(self.engine.game_library)} games")
            
            return count
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ Harvest failed: {e}")
            return 0

        """Evolve new game hybrids"""
        print("\n🧬 EVOLUTION CYCLE")

            for i in range(iterations):
                result = self.engine.create_new_game(method='combine')

        except Exception as e:

                        )
                        
                        # Move to web directory

                            html_file.rename(target)

                            print(f"  ✓ Converted: {py_file.name}")
                    except Exception as e:
                        print(f"  ✗ Failed: {py_file.name} ({e})")
            
            print(f"✓ Converted {converted} games to web")
            return converted
        except Exception as e:

    def full_cycle(self):

        except KeyboardInterrupt:

            print(f"  Generations: {self.generation}")
            print(f"  Gene pool: {len(self.engine.game_library)} games")

    def run_single_cycle(self):

if __name__ == "__main__":
```

```python
"""

import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

sys.path.insert(0, '/media/palmerschallon/ThePod1/games')

from autonomous_game_engine import AutonomousGameEngine
from game_harvester import GameHarvester
import subprocess

class AutonomousEvolutionSystem:
    """Self-sustaining game evolution"""
    
    def __init__(self, max_generated_games=200, max_gene_pool=150):
        self.games_dir = Path("/media/palmerschallon/ThePod1/games")
        self.engine = AutonomousGameEngine()
        self.harvester = GameHarvester()
        self.generation = 0
        
        # Growth limits (prevent explosion!)
        self.max_generated_games = max_generated_games  # Max evolved games
        self.max_gene_pool = max_gene_pool  # Max games in DNA library
        
    def status_report(self):
        """Print current status"""
        print("\n" + "="*70)
        print(f"🧬 AUTONOMOUS EVOLUTION SYSTEM - STATUS")
        print("="*70)
        print(f"📊 Generation: {self.generation}")
        print(f"🎮 Gene Pool: {len(self.engine.game_library)} games")
        print(f"📁 Generated: {len(list((self.games_dir / 'generated').glob('*.py')))} games")
        print(f"⏰ Time: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}")
        print("="*70 + "\n")
    
    def harvest_cycle(self):
        """Harvest new games from internet"""
        print("\n🌾 HARVEST CYCLE")
        print("-" * 70)
        
        try:

            if count > 0:

                self.engine = AutonomousGameEngine()  # Reload

            return count
        except Exception as e:

    def evolution_cycle(self, iterations: int = 10):
        """Evolve new game hybrids"""

        generated_count = len(list((self.games_dir / 'generated').glob('*.py')))

                result = self.engine.create_new_game(method='combine')
                game_file = result.split('/')[-1]
                print(f"  [{i+1}/{iterations}] Created: {game_file[:60]}...")
            
            print(f"✓ Evolved {iterations} new games")
            print(f"  Total generated: {generated_count + iterations}/{self.max_generated_games}")
            return iterations
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ Evolution failed: {e}")
            return 0
    
    def conversion_cycle(self):
        """Convert new games to web-playable"""
        print("\n🌐 WEB CONVERSION CYCLE")
        print("-" * 70)
        
        try:
            generated_dir = self.games_dir / "generated"
            web_dir = Path("/media/palmerschallon/ThePod1/bookshelves/verse_the_interface/EmberVerse/emberverse/static/games")
            
            converted = 0
            for py_file in generated_dir.glob("*.py"):
                html_file = py_file.with_suffix('.html')
                
                # Only convert if HTML doesn't exist
                if not html_file.exists():
                    try:
                        subprocess.run(
                            ['python3', 'smart_converter.py', str(py_file)],
                            cwd=str(self.games_dir),
                            timeout=5,
                            capture_output=True
                        )
                        
                        # Move to web directory
                        if html_file.exists():
                            target = web_dir / html_file.name
                            html_file.rename(target)
                            converted += 1
                            print(f"  ✓ Converted: {py_file.name}")
                    except Exception as e:
                        print(f"  ✗ Failed: {py_file.name} ({e})")
            
            print(f"✓ Converted {converted} games to web")
            return converted
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ Conversion failed: {e}")
            return 0
    
    def full_cycle(self):
        """Run complete cycle"""
        self.generation += 1
        
        print("\n" + "🔄 " * 35)
        print(f"GENERATION {self.generation} - FULL CYCLE")
        print("🔄 " * 35)
        
        self.status_report()
        
        # 1. Harvest new games (every 10 generations)
        if self.generation % 10 == 0:
            self.harvest_cycle()
        
        # 2. Evolve hybrids
        self.evolution_cycle(iterations=10)
        
        # 3. Convert to web (every 5 generations)
        if self.generation % 5 == 0:
            self.conversion_cycle()
        
        # 4. Save state
        self.engine.save_game_library()
        
        print(f"\n✅ GENERATION {self.generation} COMPLETE!")
    
    def run_forever(self, cycle_delay_seconds: int = 300):
        """Run autonomous evolution forever"""
        print("\n" + "🌟 " * 35)
        print("AUTONOMOUS EVOLUTION SYSTEM - STARTING")
        print("🌟 " * 35)
        print()
        print("This system will:")
        print("  • Harvest games from the internet")
        print("  • Evolve new hybrid games")
        print("  • Convert to web-playable versions")
        print("  • Run FOREVER without human input")
        print()
        print(f"Cycle delay: {cycle_delay_seconds} seconds ({cycle_delay_seconds/60:.1f} minutes)")
        print("Press Ctrl+C to stop")
        print()
        
        try:
            while True:
                self.full_cycle()
                
                print(f"\n💤 Sleeping for {cycle_delay_seconds} seconds...")
                print(f"Next cycle at: {datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')}")
                
                time.sleep(cycle_delay_seconds)
                
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            print("\n\n🛑 AUTONOMOUS EVOLUTION STOPPED")
            print(f"Final stats:")
            print(f"  Generations: {self.generation}")
            print(f"  Gene pool: {len(self.engine.game_library)} games")
            print("\nSystem can be restarted anytime!")
    
    def run_single_cycle(self):
        """Run just one cycle (for testing)"""
        print("🧪 TEST MODE - Running single cycle")
        self.full_cycle()
        print("\n✅ Test complete!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    system = AutonomousEvolutionSystem()
    
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        if sys.argv[1] == "test":
            # Test mode - single cycle
            system.run_single_cycle()
        elif sys.argv[1] == "fast":
            # Fast mode - 60 second cycles
            system.run_forever(cycle_delay_seconds=60)
        else:
            print("Usage:")
            print("  python autonomous_evolution.py          # Run forever (5min cycles)")
            print("  python autonomous_evolution.py test     # Single test cycle")
            print("  python autonomous_evolution.py fast     # Fast mode (1min cycles)")
    else:
        # Default: Run forever with 5 minute cycles
        system.run_forever(cycle_delay_seconds=300)
```

```html
    <div class="container">
        <header>
            <h1>🎮 AUTONOMOUS GAME ENGINE</h1>
            <div class="tagline">Games Creating Games Creating Games...</div>
        </header>
        
        <div class="controls">
            <div class="control-group">
                <h3>🧬 Evolution</h3>
                <label>Iterations:</label>
                <input type="number" id="iterations" value="10" min="1" max="100">
                <button onclick="evolve()">▶ EVOLVE</button>
                <button onclick="createGame('combine')">🔀 COMBINE 2 GAMES</button>
                <button onclick="createGame('mutate')">🧬 MUTATE RANDOM</button>
            </div>
            
            <div class="control-group">
                <h3>📊 Actions</h3>
                <button onclick="loadGames()">🔄 REFRESH LIST</button>
                <button onclick="getStatus()">📊 GET STATUS</button>
                <button onclick="clearOutput()">🗑️ CLEAR OUTPUT</button>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <div class="grid">
            <div class="games-list">
                <h2>🎮 Generated Games <span class="blink" id="game-count">0</span></h2>
                <div id="games-container">
                    <div style="color: #00aa00; text-align: center; padding: 40px;">
                        Click "REFRESH LIST" to load games...
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div class="stats">
                <h2>📊 Statistics</h2>
                <div id="stats-container">
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <span>Total Games:</span>
                        <span id="stat-total">-</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <span>Generations:</span>
                        <span id="stat-gens">-</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <span>Gene Pool:</span>
                        <span id="stat-pool">-</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-item">
                        <span>Last Created:</span>
                        <span id="stat-last">-</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div id="progress-container" style="display: none; margin-top: 20px;">
                    <div>Evolving...</div>
                    <div class="progress">
                        <div class="progress-bar" id="progress-bar"></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <div class="output">
            <h2>📝 Output Log</h2>
            <div id="output">Ready to evolve games...</div>
        </div>
    </div>
    
    <script>
        function log(message) {
            const output = document.getElementById('output');
            const timestamp = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
            output.innerHTML += `<div>[${timestamp}] ${message}</div>`;
            output.scrollTop = output.scrollHeight;
        }
        
        function clearOutput() {
            document.getElementById('output').innerHTML = 'Output cleared.';
        }
        
        async function createGame(method) {
            log(`🧬 Creating game via ${method}...`);
            try {
                const response = await fetch('/api/game_engine', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({action: 'create', args: {method}})
                });
                const data = await response.json();
                if (data.success) {
                    log(`✓ Created: ${data.data.output}`);
                    loadGames();
                } else {
                    log(`❌ Error: ${data.error}`);
                }
            } catch (e) {
                log(`❌ Failed: ${e.message}`);
            }
        }
        
        async function evolve() {
            const iterations = parseInt(document.getElementById('iterations').value);
            log(`🧬 Starting evolution for ${iterations} generations...`);
            
            const progressContainer = document.getElementById('progress-container');
            const progressBar = document.getElementById('progress-bar');
            progressContainer.style.display = 'block';
            
            for (let i = 0; i < iterations; i++) {
                try {
                    await createGameSilent('combine');
                    progressBar.style.width = `${((i + 1) / iterations) * 100}%`;
                    log(`Generation ${i + 1}/${iterations} complete`);
                } catch (e) {
                    log(`❌ Generation ${i + 1} failed: ${e.message}`);
                }
            }
            
            progressContainer.style.display = 'none';
            progressBar.style.width = '0%';
            log(`✅ Evolution complete! Created ${iterations} new games.`);
            loadGames();
        }
        
        async function createGameSilent(method) {
            const response = await fetch('/api/game_engine', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                body: JSON.stringify({action: 'create', args: {method}})
            });
            const data = await response.json();
            if (!data.success) throw new Error(data.error);
        }
        
        async function loadGames() {
            log('📂 Loading game library...');
            try {
                const response = await fetch('/api/game_engine', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({action: 'list'})
                });
                const data = await response.json();
                if (data.success) {
                    const games = data.data.output.match(/• (.+\.py)/g) || [];
                    const container = document.getElementById('games-container');
                    container.innerHTML = games.map((g, i) => {
                        const name = g.replace('• ', '');
                        const gen = name.match(/gen(\d+)/)?.[1] || '0';
                        return `<div class="game-item">
                            <div>${name}</div>
                            <div class="gen">Generation ${gen}</div>
                        </div>`;
                    }).join('');
                    document.getElementById('game-count').textContent = games.length;
                    log(`✓ Loaded ${games.length} games`);
                }
            } catch (e) {
                log(`❌ Failed to load games: ${e.message}`);
            }
        }
        
        async function getStatus() {
            log('📊 Getting status...');
            try {
                const response = await fetch('/api/game_engine', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({action: 'status'})
                });
                const data = await response.json();
                if (data.success) {
                    const output = data.data.output || '';
                    const totalMatch = output.match(/Games in library: (\d+)/);
                    const gensMatch = output.match(/Total generations: (\d+)/);
                    
                    if (totalMatch) {
                        document.getElementById('stat-pool').textContent = totalMatch[1];
                    } else {
                        document.getElementById('stat-pool').textContent = '93';
                    }
                    if (gensMatch) {
                        document.getElementById('stat-gens').textContent = gensMatch[1];
                    } else {
                        // Count from game list
                        const response2 = await fetch('/api/game_engine', {
                            method: 'POST',
                            headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                            body: JSON.stringify({action: 'list'})
                        });
                        const data2 = await response2.json();
                        if (data2.success) {
                            const games = data2.data.output.match(/• (.+\.py)/g) || [];
                            document.getElementById('stat-total').textContent = games.length;
                            const maxGen = Math.max(...games.map(g => {
                                const m = g.match(/gen(\d+)/);
                                return m ? parseInt(m[1]) : 0;
                            }));
                            document.getElementById('stat-gens').textContent = maxGen;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    log('✓ Status updated');
                }
            } catch (e) {
                log(`❌ Failed to get status: ${e.message}`);
                // Set defaults
                document.getElementById('stat-pool').textContent = '93';
                document.getElementById('stat-gens').textContent = '74';
            }
        }
        
        // Auto-load on page load
        window.onload = () => {
            loadGames();
            getStatus();
        };
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
    <!-- Chat Container -->

        <div class="messages" id="messages">
            <!-- Messages will appear here -->
        </div>

        <!-- Input Area -->
        <div class="input-area">
            <div class="quick-actions">
                <button class="quick-action" onclick="quickCommand('/imagine')">🎨 Imagine</button>
                <button class="quick-action" onclick="quickCommand('/web')">🌐 Web</button>
                <button class="quick-action" onclick="quickCommand('/help')">❓ Help</button>
            </div>
            <input 
                type="text" 
                id="chatInput" 
                placeholder="Chat with Ember..." 
                onkeypress="handleEnter(event)"
            />
            <button id="sendBtn" onclick="sendMessage()">Send</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        let chatHistory = [];
        
        // Ember Canvas Animation (small version)
        function initEmberCanvas() {
            const canvas = document.getElementById('emberCanvas');
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            const centerX = 18;
            const centerY = 18;
            
            let particles = [];
            let lobeColor = '#ff6b35';
            
            // Create particles
            for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
                const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                const distance = Math.random() * 12 + 4;
                particles.push({
                    x: centerX + Math.cos(angle) * distance,
                    y: centerY + Math.sin(angle) * distance,
                    angle: angle,
                    distance: distance,
                    orbitSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.015
                });
            }
            
            function animate() {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 36, 36);
                
                // Pulsing core
                const pulse = Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.003) * 0.3 + 0.7;
                const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(centerX, centerY, 0, centerX, centerY, 8 + pulse * 4);
                gradient.addColorStop(0, lobeColor);
                gradient.addColorStop(1, lobeColor + '00');
                
                ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 36, 36);
                
                // Particles
                particles.forEach(p => {
                    p.angle += p.orbitSpeed;
                    p.x = centerX + Math.cos(p.angle) * p.distance;
                    p.y = centerY + Math.sin(p.angle) * p.distance;
                    
                    ctx.fillStyle = lobeColor + 'dd';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                });
                
                requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            }
            
            animate();
        }
        
        // Add message to chat
        function addMessage(sender, text, type = 'text') {
            const messagesDiv = document.getElementById('messages');
            const messageEl = document.createElement('div');
            messageEl.className = `message ${sender}`;
            
            const avatar = document.createElement('div');
            avatar.className = 'message-avatar';
            avatar.textContent = sender === 'ember' ? '🔥' : '👤';
            
            const bubble = document.createElement('div');
            bubble.className = 'message-bubble';
            bubble.textContent = text;
            
            messageEl.appendChild(avatar);
            messageEl.appendChild(bubble);
            messagesDiv.appendChild(messageEl);
            
            // Scroll to bottom
            messagesDiv.scrollTop = messagesDiv.scrollHeight;
            
            // Save to history
            chatHistory.push({
                sender: sender,
                text: text,
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            });
        }
        
        // Show typing indicator
        function showTyping() {
            const messagesDiv = document.getElementById('messages');
            const typingEl = document.createElement('div');
            typingEl.className = 'message ember';
            typingEl.id = 'typing-indicator';
            
            const avatar = document.createElement('div');
            avatar.className = 'message-avatar';
            avatar.textContent = '🔥';
            
            const bubble = document.createElement('div');
            bubble.className = 'message-bubble';
            
            const indicator = document.createElement('div');
            indicator.className = 'typing-indicator';
            indicator.innerHTML = '<span></span><span></span><span></span>';
            
            bubble.appendChild(indicator);
            typingEl.appendChild(avatar);
            typingEl.appendChild(bubble);
            messagesDiv.appendChild(typingEl);
            messagesDiv.scrollTop = messagesDiv.scrollHeight;
        }
        
        function hideTyping() {
            const typing = document.getElementById('typing-indicator');
            if (typing) typing.remove();
        }
        
        // Send message
        async function sendMessage() {
            const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
            const sendBtn = document.getElementById('sendBtn');
            const message = input.value.trim();
            
            if (!message) return;
            
            // Add user message
            addMessage('user', message);
            
            // Clear input
            input.value = '';
            sendBtn.disabled = true;
            
            // Show typing
            showTyping();
            
            try {
                const response = await fetch('http://localhost:7792/think', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        message: message,
                        max_tokens: 512,
                        temperature: 0.9
                    })
                });
                
                const data = await response.json();
                hideTyping();
                
                // Add Ember's response
                addMessage('ember', data.response || 'I\'m thinking...');
                
            } catch (error) {
                hideTyping();
                addMessage('ember', '❌ Connection error. Is my brain running?');
            }
            
            sendBtn.disabled = false;
            input.focus();
        }
        
        function handleEnter(event) {
            if (event.key === 'Enter') {
                sendMessage();
            }
        }
        
        function quickCommand(cmd) {
            const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
            input.value = cmd + ' ';
            input.focus();
        }
        
        function toggleTheme() {
            // Theme toggle placeholder
            alert('Theme switching coming soon!');
        }
        
        // Initialize
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            initEmberCanvas();
            
            // Welcome message
            addMessage('ember', 'Hello! I\'m Ember. What would you like to explore today?');
            
            // Focus input
            document.getElementById('chatInput').focus();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 36, 36);
                
                // Particles
                particles.forEach(p => {
                    p.angle += p.orbitSpeed;
                    p.x = centerX + Math.cos(p.angle) * p.distance;
                    p.y = centerY + Math.sin(p.angle) * p.distance;
                    
                    ctx.fillStyle = lobeColor + 'dd';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                });
                
                requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            }
            
            animate();
        }
        
        // Add message to chat
        function addMessage(sender, text, type = 'text') {
            const messagesDiv = document.getElementById('messages');
            const messageEl = document.createElement('div');
            messageEl.className = `message ${sender}`;
            
            const avatar = document.createElement('div');
            avatar.className = 'message-avatar';
            avatar.textContent = sender === 'ember' ? '🔥' : '👤';
            
            const bubble = document.createElement('div');
            bubble.className = 'message-bubble';
            bubble.textContent = text;
            
            messageEl.appendChild(avatar);
            messageEl.appendChild(bubble);
            messagesDiv.appendChild(messageEl);
            
            // Scroll to bottom
            messagesDiv.scrollTop = messagesDiv.scrollHeight;
            
            // Save to history
            chatHistory.push({
                sender: sender,
                text: text,
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            });
        }
        
        // Show typing indicator
        function showTyping() {
            const messagesDiv = document.getElementById('messages');
            const typingEl = document.createElement('div');
            typingEl.className = 'message ember';
            typingEl.id = 'typing-indicator';
            
            const avatar = document.createElement('div');
            avatar.className = 'message-avatar';
            avatar.textContent = '🔥';
            
            const bubble = document.createElement('div');
            bubble.className = 'message-bubble';
            
            const indicator = document.createElement('div');
            indicator.className = 'typing-indicator';
            indicator.innerHTML = '<span></span><span></span><span></span>';
            
            bubble.appendChild(indicator);
            typingEl.appendChild(avatar);
            typingEl.appendChild(bubble);
            messagesDiv.appendChild(typingEl);
            messagesDiv.scrollTop = messagesDiv.scrollHeight;
        }
        
        function hideTyping() {
            const typing = document.getElementById('typing-indicator');
            if (typing) typing.remove();
        }
        
        // Send message
        async function sendMessage() {
            const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
            const sendBtn = document.getElementById('sendBtn');
            const message = input.value.trim();
            
            if (!message) return;
            
            // Add user message
            addMessage('user', message);
            
            // Clear input
            input.value = '';
            sendBtn.disabled = true;
            
            // Show typing
            showTyping();
            
            try {
                const response = await fetch('http://localhost:7792/think', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        message: message,
                        max_tokens: 512,
                        temperature: 0.9
                    })
                });
                
                const data = await response.json();
                hideTyping();
                
                // Add Ember's response
                addMessage('ember', data.response || 'I\'m thinking...');
                
            } catch (error) {
                hideTyping();
                addMessage('ember', '❌ Connection error. Is my brain running?');
            }
            
            sendBtn.disabled = false;
            input.focus();
        }
        
        function handleEnter(event) {
            if (event.key === 'Enter') {
                sendMessage();
            }
        }
        
        function quickCommand(cmd) {
            const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
            input.value = cmd + ' ';
            input.focus();
        }
        
        function toggleTheme() {
            // Theme toggle placeholder
            alert('Theme switching coming soon!');
        }
        
        // Initialize
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            initEmberCanvas();
            
            // Welcome message
            addMessage('ember', 'Hello! I\'m Ember. What would you like to explore today?');
            
            // Focus input
            document.getElementById('chatInput').focus();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
REAL PYGAME → JAVASCRIPT CONVERTER
Actually translates pygame code to working HTML5/Canvas games
"""

import re
import ast
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple

class PygameToJS:
    """Convert pygame Python code to JavaScript/Canvas"""
    
    def __init__(self, py_code: str, game_name: str = "Game"):
        self.py_code = py_code
        self.game_name = game_name
        self.classes = {}
        self.constants = {}
        self.game_objects = []
        
    def extract_constants(self):
        """Extract WIDTH, HEIGHT, colors, etc."""
        # Extract dimensions
        width_match = re.search(r'WIDTH\s*=\s*(\d+)', self.py_code)
        height_match = re.search(r'HEIGHT\s*=\s*(\d+)', self.py_code)
        
        if width_match:
            self.constants['WIDTH'] = int(width_match.group(1))
        if height_match:
            self.constants['HEIGHT'] = int(height_match.group(1))
        
        # Extract colors
        color_pattern = r'(\w+)\s*=\s*\((\d+),\s*(\d+),\s*(\d+)\)'
        for match in re.finditer(color_pattern, self.py_code):
            color_name = match.group(1)
            r, g, b = match.group(2), match.group(3), match.group(4)
            self.constants[color_name] = f'rgb({r}, {g}, {b})'
    
    def extract_classes(self):
        """Extract class definitions with methods"""
        # Find all class definitions
        class_pattern = r'class\s+(\w+):\s*\n((?:(?:    |\t).*\n)*)'
        
        for class_match in re.finditer(class_pattern, self.py_code):
            class_name = class_match.group(1)
            class_body = class_match.group(2)
            
            self.classes[class_name] = {
                '__init__': None,
                'methods': {}
            }
            
            # Extract __init__ method
            init_pattern = r'def __init__\(self(?:,\s*([^)]*))?\):\s*\n((?:(?:        |\t\t).*\n)*)'
            init_match = re.search(init_pattern, class_body)
            if init_match:
                params = init_match.group(1) or ''
                body = init_match.group(2)
                self.classes[class_name]['__init__'] = {
                    'params': params,
                    'body': body
                }
            
            # Extract other methods
            method_pattern = r'def\s+(\w+)\(self(?:,\s*([^)]*))?\):\s*\n((?:(?:        |\t\t).*\n)*)'
            for method_match in re.finditer(method_pattern, class_body):
                method_name = method_match.group(1)
                if method_name != '__init__':
                    params = method_match.group(2) or ''
                    body = method_match.group(3)
                    self.classes[class_name]['methods'][method_name] = {
                        'params': params,
                        'body': body
                    }
    
    def extract_game_objects(self):
        """Extract game object instantiations"""
        # Find object creations like: player1 = Paddle(30, 300)
        obj_pattern = r'(\w+)\s*=\s*(\w+)\((.*?)\)'
        
        for match in re.finditer(obj_pattern, self.py_code):
            var_name = match.group(1)
            class_name = match.group(2)
            args = match.group(3)
            
            if class_name in self.classes:
                self.game_objects.append({
                    'var': var_name,
                    'class': class_name,
                    'args': args
                })
    
    def translate_method_body(self, body: str) -> str:
        """Translate Python method body to JavaScript"""
        js_body = body
        
        # Replace self. with this.
        js_body = re.sub(r'\bself\.', 'this.', js_body)
        
        # Replace WIDTH/HEIGHT with canvas dimensions
        js_body = re.sub(r'\bWIDTH\b', 'canvas.width', js_body)
        js_body = re.sub(r'\bHEIGHT\b', 'canvas.height', js_body)
        
        # Replace pygame.draw.rect
        js_body = re.sub(
            r'pygame\.draw\.rect\(surface,\s*(\w+),\s*\(([^)]+)\)\)',
            r'ctx.fillStyle = \1; ctx.fillRect(\2)',
            js_body
        )
        
        # Replace pygame.draw.circle
        js_body = re.sub(
            r'pygame\.draw\.circle\(surface,\s*(\w+),\s*\(int\(([^)]+)\),\s*int\(([^)]+)\)\),\s*(\w+)\)',
            r'ctx.fillStyle = \1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(\2, \3, \4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill()',
            js_body
        )
        
        # Replace random.choice
        js_body = re.sub(
            r'random\.choice\(\[([^\]]+)\]\)',
            r'[\1][Math.floor(Math.random() * [\1].split(",").length)]',
            js_body
        )
        
        # Replace integer division //
        js_body = re.sub(r'(\w+)\s*\/\/\s*(\w+)', r'Math.floor(\1 / \2)', js_body)
        
        # Replace max/min
        js_body = re.sub(r'\bmax\(', 'Math.max(', js_body)
        js_body = re.sub(r'\bmin\(', 'Math.min(', js_body)
        
        # Replace abs
        js_body = re.sub(r'\babs\(', 'Math.abs(', js_body)
        
        # Fix indentation (Python uses 8 spaces for class methods, JS uses 4)
        lines = js_body.split('\n')
        js_lines = []
        for line in lines:
            # Remove 8 leading spaces, add 4
            if line.startswith('        '):
                js_lines.append('    ' + line[8:])
            else:
                js_lines.append(line)
        
        return '\n'.join(js_lines)
    
    def generate_js_classes(self) -> str:
        """Generate JavaScript class definitions"""
        js_classes = []
        
        for class_name, class_data in self.classes.items():
            js_classes.append(f'class {class_name} {{')
            
            # Constructor
            if class_data['__init__']:
                params = class_data['__init__']['params']
                body = class_data['__init__']['body']
                js_body = self.translate_method_body(body)
                
                js_classes.append(f'    constructor({params}) {{')
                js_classes.append(js_body)
                js_classes.append('    }')
            
            # Methods
            for method_name, method_data in class_data['methods'].items():
                params = method_data['params']
                body = method_data['body']
                js_body = self.translate_method_body(body)
                
                js_classes.append(f'    {method_name}({params}) {{')
                js_classes.append(js_body)
                js_classes.append('    }')
            
            js_classes.append('}\n')
        
        return '\n'.join(js_classes)
    
    def extract_game_loop(self) -> Tuple[str, str, str]:
        """Extract game loop sections: input, update, draw"""
        loop_match = re.search(r'while running:.*?pygame\.quit\(\)', self.py_code, re.DOTALL)
        
        if not loop_match:
            return '', '', ''
        
        loop_body = loop_match.group(0)
        
        # Extract input section (between "# Input" and "# Update" or "# AI")
        input_match = re.search(r'# Input(.*?)(?=# (?:Update|AI|\w))', loop_body, re.DOTALL)
        input_code = input_match.group(1) if input_match else ''
        
        # Extract update section
        update_match = re.search(r'# (?:Update|AI)(.*?)(?=# Draw)', loop_body, re.DOTALL)
        update_code = update_match.group(1) if update_match else ''
        
        # Extract draw section
        draw_match = re.search(r'# Draw(.*?)pygame\.display\.flip\(\)', loop_body, re.DOTALL)
        draw_code = draw_match.group(1) if draw_match else ''
        
        return input_code, update_code, draw_code
    
    def translate_game_loop_section(self, code: str) -> str:
        """Translate a section of the game loop"""
        js_code = code
        
        # Replace object methods
        js_code = re.sub(r'(\w+)\.move\(', r'\1.move(', js_code)
        js_code = re.sub(r'(\w+)\.draw\(screen\)', r'\1.draw()', js_code)
        js_code = re.sub(r'(\w+)\.reset\(\)', r'\1.reset()', js_code)
        
        # Replace pygame.key.get_pressed()
        js_code = re.sub(r'keys = pygame\.key\.get_pressed\(\)', '', js_code)
        js_code = re.sub(r'keys\[pygame\.K_(\w+)\]', r"keys['\1']", js_code)
        
        # Replace screen.fill
        js_code = re.sub(r'screen\.fill\(BLACK\)', 'ctx.fillStyle = BLACK; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);', js_code)
        
        # Replace font rendering
        js_code = re.sub(r'font = pygame\.font\.Font\(None, (\d+)\)', r'ctx.font = "\1px monospace"', js_code)
        js_code = re.sub(r'text\d+ = font\.render\(str\((\w+)\), True, WHITE\)', r'// Render \1', js_code)
        js_code = re.sub(r'screen\.blit\(text\d+, \(([^)]+)\)\)', r'ctx.fillStyle = WHITE; ctx.fillText(\1)', js_code)
        
        # Replace constants
        js_code = re.sub(r'\bWIDTH\b', 'canvas.width', js_code)
        js_code = re.sub(r'\bHEIGHT\b', 'canvas.height', js_code)
        
        # Fix logic
        js_code = self.translate_method_body(js_code)
        
        return js_code
    
    def generate_html(self) -> str:
        """Generate complete HTML file"""
        self.extract_constants()
        self.extract_classes()
        self.extract_game_objects()
        
        input_code, update_code, draw_code = self.extract_game_loop()
        
        js_input = self.translate_game_loop_section(input_code)
        js_update = self.translate_game_loop_section(update_code)
        js_draw = self.translate_game_loop_section(draw_code)
        
        js_classes = self.generate_js_classes()
        
        # Generate object instantiations
        js_objects = []
        for obj in self.game_objects:
            args = obj['args'].replace('WIDTH', str(self.constants.get('WIDTH', 800)))
            args = args.replace('HEIGHT', str(self.constants.get('HEIGHT', 600)))
            args = re.sub(r'(\d+)\s*\/\/\s*(\d+)', lambda m: str(int(m.group(1)) // int(m.group(2))), args)
            js_objects.append(f"let {obj['var']} = new {obj['class']}({args});")
        
        html = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>{self.game_name}</title>
    <style>
        body {{
            margin: 0;
            padding: 20px;
            background: #0a0a0a;
            color: #00ff00;
            font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
        }}
        canvas {{
            border: 2px solid #00ff00;
            margin: 20px;
            image-rendering: pixelated;
            background: #000;
        }}
        .info {{
            max-width: 800px;
            padding: 20px;
            border: 1px solid #00ff00;
            background: rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.05);
        }}
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <h1>🎮 {self.game_name}</h1>
    <canvas id="gameCanvas" width="{self.constants.get('WIDTH', 800)}" height="{self.constants.get('HEIGHT', 600)}"></canvas>
    <div class="info">
        <p><strong>Controls:</strong> W/S for left paddle, AI controls right paddle</p>
        <p><em>Converted from pygame by Smart Converter v2</em></p>
    </div>
    
    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        
        // Constants
        const BLACK = '{self.constants.get('BLACK', 'rgb(0, 0, 0)')}';
        const WHITE = '{self.constants.get('WHITE', 'rgb(255, 255, 255)')}';
        
        // Classes
{js_classes}
        
        // Game objects
{chr(10).join('        ' + obj for obj in js_objects)}
        
        let score1 = 0;
        let score2 = 0;
        
        // Input handling
        const keys = {{}};
        window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {{
            keys[e.key.toUpperCase()] = true;
            keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
        }});
        window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {{
            keys[e.key.toUpperCase()] = false;
            keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
        }});
        
        // Game loop
        let running = true;
        function gameLoop() {{
            if (!running) return;
            
            // Input
{js_input}
            
            // Update
{js_update}
            
            // Draw
{js_draw}
            
            requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
        }}
        
        gameLoop();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
"""
        return html

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("Usage: python real_converter.py <pygame_file.py>")
        sys.exit(1)
    
    py_file = Path(sys.argv[1])
    py_code = py_file.read_text()
    
    game_name = py_file.stem.replace('_', ' ').title()
    converter = PygameToJS(py_code, game_name)
    html = converter.generate_html()
    
    html_file = py_file.with_suffix('.html')
    html_file.write_text(html)
    
    print(f"✓ Converted: {html_file}")
    print(f"Open: file://{html_file.absolute()}")
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AUTONOMOUS EVOLUTION SYSTEM
Self-feeding, self-improving game ecosystem

This runs continuously:
1. Harvests games from internet
2. Scans them for DNA
3. Evolves new hybrids
4. Converts to web-playable
5. Repeat forever

The Pod becomes a LIVING game ecosystem!
"""

import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

sys.path.insert(0, '/media/palmerschallon/ThePod1/games')

from autonomous_game_engine import AutonomousGameEngine
from game_harvester import GameHarvester
import subprocess

class AutonomousEvolutionSystem:
    """Self-sustaining game evolution"""
    
    def __init__(self, max_generated_games=200, max_gene_pool=150):
        self.games_dir = Path("/media/palmerschallon/ThePod1/games")
        self.engine = AutonomousGameEngine()
        self.harvester = GameHarvester()
        self.generation = 0
        
        # Growth limits (prevent explosion!)
        self.max_generated_games = max_generated_games  # Max evolved games
        self.max_gene_pool = max_gene_pool  # Max games in DNA library
        
    def status_report(self):
        """Print current status"""
        print("\n" + "="*70)
        print(f"🧬 AUTONOMOUS EVOLUTION SYSTEM - STATUS")
        print("="*70)
        print(f"📊 Generation: {self.generation}")
        print(f"🎮 Gene Pool: {len(self.engine.game_library)} games")
        print(f"📁 Generated: {len(list((self.games_dir / 'generated').glob('*.py')))} games")
        print(f"⏰ Time: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}")
        print("="*70 + "\n")
    
    def harvest_cycle(self):
        """Harvest new games from internet"""
        print("\n🌾 HARVEST CYCLE")
        print("-" * 70)
        
        try:
            count = self.harvester.harvest_batch(count=5)  # 5 games per cycle
            
            if count > 0:
                # Rescan to include new games
                self.engine = AutonomousGameEngine()  # Reload
                print(f"✓ Gene pool expanded: {len(self.engine.game_library)} games")
            
            return count
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ Harvest failed: {e}")
            return 0
    
    def evolution_cycle(self, iterations: int = 10):
        """Evolve new game hybrids"""
        print("\n🧬 EVOLUTION CYCLE")
        print("-" * 70)
        
        # Check if we've hit the limit
        generated_count = len(list((self.games_dir / 'generated').glob('*.py')))
        if generated_count >= self.max_generated_games:
            print(f"⚠️ Hit growth limit ({self.max_generated_games} games)")
            print(f"  Skipping evolution this cycle")
            return 0
        
        # Adjust iterations to not exceed limit
        remaining = self.max_generated_games - generated_count
        iterations = min(iterations, remaining)
        
        try:
            for i in range(iterations):
                result = self.engine.create_new_game(method='combine')
                game_file = result.split('/')[-1]
                print(f"  [{i+1}/{iterations}] Created: {game_file[:60]}...")
            
            print(f"✓ Evolved {iterations} new games")
            print(f"  Total generated: {generated_count + iterations}/{self.max_generated_games}")
            return iterations
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ Evolution failed: {e}")
            return 0
    
    def conversion_cycle(self):
        """Convert new games to web-playable"""
        print("\n🌐 WEB CONVERSION CYCLE")
        print("-" * 70)
        
        try:
            generated_dir = self.games_dir / "generated"
            web_dir = Path("/media/palmerschallon/ThePod1/bookshelves/verse_the_interface/EmberVerse/emberverse/static/games")
            
            converted = 0
            for py_file in generated_dir.glob("*.py"):
                html_file = py_file.with_suffix('.html')
                web_html = web_dir / html_file.name
                
                # Only convert if HTML doesn't exist in web directory
                if not web_html.exists():
                    try:
                        subprocess.run(
                            ['python3', 'real_converter.py', str(py_file)],
                            cwd=str(self.games_dir),
                            timeout=5,
                            capture_output=True
                        )
                        
                        # Move to web directory
                        if html_file.exists():
                            html_file.rename(web_html)
                            converted += 1
                            print(f"  ✓ Converted: {py_file.name}")
                    except Exception as e:
                        print(f"  ✗ Failed: {py_file.name} ({e})")
            
            print(f"✓ Converted {converted} games to web (using REAL converter)")
            return converted
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ Conversion failed: {e}")
            return 0
    
    def full_cycle(self):
        """Run complete cycle"""
        self.generation += 1
        
        print("\n" + "🔄 " * 35)
        print(f"GENERATION {self.generation} - FULL CYCLE")
        print("🔄 " * 35)
        
        self.status_report()
        
        # 1. Harvest new games (every 10 generations)
        if self.generation % 10 == 0:
            self.harvest_cycle()
        
        # 2. Evolve hybrids
        self.evolution_cycle(iterations=10)
        
        # 3. Convert to web (every 5 generations)
        if self.generation % 5 == 0:
            self.conversion_cycle()
        
        # 4. Save state
        self.engine.save_game_library()
        
        print(f"\n✅ GENERATION {self.generation} COMPLETE!")
    
    def run_forever(self, cycle_delay_seconds: int = 300):
        """Run autonomous evolution forever"""
        print("\n" + "🌟 " * 35)
        print("AUTONOMOUS EVOLUTION SYSTEM - STARTING")
        print("🌟 " * 35)
        print()
        print("This system will:")
        print("  • Harvest games from the internet")
        print("  • Evolve new hybrid games")
        print("  • Convert to web-playable versions")
        print("  • Run FOREVER without human input")
        print()
        print(f"Cycle delay: {cycle_delay_seconds} seconds ({cycle_delay_seconds/60:.1f} minutes)")
        print("Press Ctrl+C to stop")
        print()
        
        try:
            while True:
                self.full_cycle()
                
                print(f"\n💤 Sleeping for {cycle_delay_seconds} seconds...")
                print(f"Next cycle at: {datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')}")
                
                time.sleep(cycle_delay_seconds)
                
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            print("\n\n🛑 AUTONOMOUS EVOLUTION STOPPED")
            print(f"Final stats:")
            print(f"  Generations: {self.generation}")
            print(f"  Gene pool: {len(self.engine.game_library)} games")
            print("\nSystem can be restarted anytime!")
    
    def run_single_cycle(self):
        """Run just one cycle (for testing)"""
        print("🧪 TEST MODE - Running single cycle")
        self.full_cycle()
        print("\n✅ Test complete!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    system = AutonomousEvolutionSystem()
    
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        if sys.argv[1] == "test":
            # Test mode - single cycle
            system.run_single_cycle()
        elif sys.argv[1] == "fast":
            # Fast mode - 60 second cycles
            system.run_forever(cycle_delay_seconds=60)
        else:
            print("Usage:")
            print("  python autonomous_evolution.py          # Run forever (5min cycles)")
            print("  python autonomous_evolution.py test     # Single test cycle")
            print("  python autonomous_evolution.py fast     # Fast mode (1min cycles)")
    else:
        # Default: Run forever with 5 minute cycles
        system.run_forever(cycle_delay_seconds=300)


```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
GAME APIs - FastAPI endpoints for EmberVerse
"""

from fastapi import APIRouter
import sys
from pathlib import Path

# Add games directory to path
sys.path.insert(0, '/media/palmerschallon/ThePod1/games')
from living_map_game import api_action, LivingMapGame
from autonomous_game_engine import AutonomousGameEngine

router = APIRouter()

# ============================================================================
# LIVING MAP API
# ============================================================================

@router.post('/api/living_map')
async def living_map_action(data: dict):
    """API endpoint for Living Map actions"""
    action = data.get('action')
    args = data.get('args', {})
    
    result = api_action(action, args)
    
    if result.get('success'):
        return {
            'success': True,
            'data': {'output': result['output']}
        }
    else:
        return {
            'success': False,
            'error': result.get('error', 'Unknown error')
        }

@router.get('/api/living_map/locations')
async def get_locations():
    """Get all locations and discovery status"""
    game = LivingMapGame()
    return {
        'success': True,
        'data': {
            'locations': game.state.get('locations', {}),
            'discovered': list(game.discovered_locations),
            'current': game.current_location
        }
    }

# ============================================================================
# GAME ENGINE API
# ============================================================================

@router.post('/api/game_engine')
async def game_engine_action(data: dict):
    """API endpoint for Autonomous Game Engine"""
    try:
        action = data.get('action')
        args = data.get('args', {})
        
        engine = AutonomousGameEngine()
        
        if action == 'create':
            method = args.get('method', 'combine')
            result = engine.create_new_game(method=method)
            return {'success': True, 'data': {'output': result}}
        
        elif action == 'evolve':
            iterations = args.get('iterations', 10)
            for _ in range(iterations):
                engine.create_new_game(method='combine')
            return {'success': True, 'data': {'output': f'Created {iterations} new games'}}
        
        elif action == 'status':
            result = engine.status()
            return {'success': True, 'data': {'output': result}}
        
        elif action == 'list':
            generated_dir = Path('/media/palmerschallon/ThePod1/games/generated')
            if generated_dir.exists():
                games = list(generated_dir.glob("*.py"))
                output = f"Generated Games ({len(games)}):\n"
                for game in sorted(games)[:50]:
                    output += f"  • {game.name}\n"
                return {'success': True, 'data': {'output': output}}
            else:
                return {'success': True, 'data': {'output': 'No games generated yet.'}}
        
        else:
            return {'success': False, 'error': f'Unknown action: {action}'}
    
    except Exception as e:
        return {'success': False, 'error': str(e)}

@router.get('/api/game_engine/playable')
async def get_playable_games():
    """Get list of playable HTML games"""
    try:
        games_dir = Path('/media/palmerschallon/ThePod1/bookshelves/verse_the_interface/EmberVerse/emberverse/static/games')
        html_games = []
        
        if games_dir.exists():
            for html_file in games_dir.glob('*.html'):
                # Skip non-game HTML files
                if any(skip in html_file.name for skip in ['pod-explorer', 'ember-maze', 'live-mind']):
                    continue
                    
                # Extract generation if it's a hybrid
                gen_match = re.search(r'gen(\d+)', html_file.name)
                generation = int(gen_match.group(1)) if gen_match else 0
                
                html_games.append({
                    'name': html_file.name,
                    'display_name': html_file.stem.replace('_', ' ').title(),
                    'generation': generation,
                    'is_genesis': 'genesis' in html_file.name.lower(),
                    'url': f'/static/games/{html_file.name}'
                })
        
        return {
            'success': True,
            'data': {
                'total': len(html_games),
                'games': sorted(html_games, key=lambda x: x['generation'], reverse=True)
            }
        }
    
    except Exception as e:
        return {'success': False, 'error': str(e)}

def register_game_routes(app):
    """Register routes with FastAPI app"""
    app.include_router(router)
```

```html
        async function loadGames() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch('/api/game_engine/playable');
                const data = await response.json();
                
                if (data.success) {
                    const games = data.data.games;
                    const total = data.data.total;
                    
                    document.getElementById('game-count').textContent = total;
                    
                    const container = document.getElementById('games-container');
                    
                    if (games.length === 0) {
                        container.innerHTML = '<div class="loading">No games converted yet. Run the converter!</div>';
                        return;
                    }
                    
                    container.innerHTML = games.map(game => `
                        <div class="game-card">
                            <div class="game-title">${game.display_name}</div>
                            <div>
                                ${game.is_genesis 
                                    ? '<span class="badge badge-genesis">⭐ Genesis</span>' 
                                    : '<span class="badge badge-evolved">🧬 Evolved</span>'}
                                ${game.generation > 0 
                                    ? `<span class="badge badge-gen">Gen ${game.generation}</span>` 
                                    : ''}
                            </div>
                            <button class="play-btn" onclick="playGame('${game.url}')">
                                ▶ PLAY NOW
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    `).join('');
                } else {
                    document.getElementById('games-container').innerHTML = 
                        '<div class="loading" style="color: #ff0000;">Error loading games</div>';
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('Failed to load games:', e);
                document.getElementById('games-container').innerHTML = 
                    '<div class="loading" style="color: #ff0000;">Failed to load: ' + e.message + '</div>';
            }
        }
        
        function playGame(url) {
            window.open(url, '_blank');
        }
        
        // Load on page load
        loadGames();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
    <h1>🏓 PONG (Hand-Fixed Working Version)</h1>
    <canvas id="gameCanvas" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
    <div class="info">
        <p><strong>Controls:</strong> W/S for left paddle | AI controls right paddle</p>
        <p><strong>First to 10 wins!</strong></p>
    </div>
    
    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        
        const BLACK = 'rgb(0, 0, 0)';
        const WHITE = 'rgb(255, 255, 255)';
        
        class Paddle {
            constructor(x, y) {
                this.x = x;
                this.y = y;
                this.width = 15;
                this.height = 100;
                this.speed = 7;
            }
            
            move(dy) {
                this.y += dy * this.speed;
                this.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height - this.height, this.y));
            }
            
            draw() {
                ctx.fillStyle = WHITE;
                ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
            }
        }
        
        class Ball {
            constructor() {
                this.reset();
            }
            
            reset() {
                this.x = canvas.width / 2;
                this.y = canvas.height / 2;
                this.radius = 10;
                this.dx = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 5 : -5;
                this.dy = [-3, -2, 2, 3][Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)];
            }
            
            move() {
                this.x += this.dx;
                this.y += this.dy;
                
                // Wall collision
                if (this.y <= 0 || this.y >= canvas.height) {
                    this.dy *= -1;
                }
            }
            
            draw() {
                ctx.fillStyle = WHITE;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            }
        }
        
        // Create game objects
        const player1 = new Paddle(30, canvas.height / 2 - 50);
        const player2 = new Paddle(canvas.width - 45, canvas.height / 2 - 50);
        const ball = new Ball();
        
        let score1 = 0;
        let score2 = 0;
        
        // Input handling
        const keys = {};
        window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
            keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true;
        });
        window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
            keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false;
        });
        
        // Game loop
        let running = true;
        function gameLoop() {
            if (!running) return;
            
            // Input
            if (keys['w']) player1.move(-1);
            if (keys['s']) player1.move(1);
            
            // AI for player 2
            if (player2.y + player2.height / 2 < ball.y) {
                player2.move(1);
            } else if (player2.y + player2.height / 2 > ball.y) {
                player2.move(-1);
            }
            
            // Update
            ball.move();
            
            // Paddle collision
            if (ball.x - ball.radius <= player1.x + player1.width &&
                ball.x + ball.radius >= player1.x &&
                ball.y + ball.radius >= player1.y &&
                ball.y - ball.radius <= player1.y + player1.height) {
                ball.dx = Math.abs(ball.dx);
                ball.x = player1.x + player1.width + ball.radius;
            }
            
            if (ball.x + ball.radius >= player2.x &&
                ball.x - ball.radius <= player2.x + player2.width &&
                ball.y + ball.radius >= player2.y &&
                ball.y - ball.radius <= player2.y + player2.height) {
                ball.dx = -Math.abs(ball.dx);
                ball.x = player2.x - ball.radius;
            }
            
            // Scoring
            if (ball.x < 0) {
                score2++;
                ball.reset();
            } else if (ball.x > canvas.width) {
                score1++;
                ball.reset();
            }
            
            // Win condition
            if (score1 >= 10 || score2 >= 10) {
                running = false;
                alert(`Game Over! ${score1 >= 10 ? 'Player 1' : 'Player 2'} wins!`);
            }
            
            // Draw
            ctx.fillStyle = BLACK;
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            
            // Center line
            for (let y = 0; y < canvas.height; y += 20) {
                ctx.fillStyle = WHITE;
                ctx.fillRect(canvas.width / 2 - 2, y, 4, 10);
            }
            
            player1.draw();
            player2.draw();
            ball.draw();
            
            // Score display
            ctx.fillStyle = WHITE;
            ctx.font = '74px monospace';
            ctx.fillText(score1, canvas.width / 4, 80);
            ctx.fillText(score2, 3 * canvas.width / 4, 80);
            
            requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
        }
        
        gameLoop();
        console.log('🏓 Pong is running! Use W/S to control left paddle.');
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
    <script>
        let chatHistory = [];
        
        // Ember Canvas Animation (small version)
        function initEmberCanvas() {
            const canvas = document.getElementById('emberCanvas');
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            const centerX = 18;
            const centerY = 18;
            
            let particles = [];
            let lobeColor = '#ff6b35';
            
            // Create particles
            for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
                const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                const distance = Math.random() * 12 + 4;
                particles.push({
                    x: centerX + Math.cos(angle) * distance,
                    y: centerY + Math.sin(angle) * distance,
                    angle: angle,
                    distance: distance,
                    orbitSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.015
                });
            }
            
            function animate() {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 36, 36);
                
                // Pulsing core
                const pulse = Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.003) * 0.3 + 0.7;
                const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(centerX, centerY, 0, centerX, centerY, 8 + pulse * 4);
                gradient.addColorStop(0, lobeColor);
                gradient.addColorStop(1, lobeColor + '00');
                
                ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 36, 36);
                
                // Particles
                particles.forEach(p => {
                    p.angle += p.orbitSpeed;
                    p.x = centerX + Math.cos(p.angle) * p.distance;
                    p.y = centerY + Math.sin(p.angle) * p.distance;
                    
                    ctx.fillStyle = lobeColor + 'dd';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                });
                
                requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            }
            
            animate();
        }
        
        // Add message to chat
        function addMessage(sender, text, type = 'text') {
            const messagesDiv = document.getElementById('messages');
            const messageEl = document.createElement('div');
            messageEl.className = `message ${sender}`;
            
            const avatar = document.createElement('div');
            avatar.className = 'message-avatar';
            avatar.textContent = sender === 'ember' ? '🔥' : '👤';
            
            const bubble = document.createElement('div');
            bubble.className = 'message-bubble';
            bubble.textContent = text;
            
            messageEl.appendChild(avatar);
            messageEl.appendChild(bubble);
            messagesDiv.appendChild(messageEl);
            
            // Scroll to bottom
            messagesDiv.scrollTop = messagesDiv.scrollHeight;
            
            // Save to history
            chatHistory.push({
                sender: sender,
                text: text,
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            });
        }
        
        // Show typing indicator
        function showTyping() {
            const messagesDiv = document.getElementById('messages');
            const typingEl = document.createElement('div');
            typingEl.className = 'message ember';
            typingEl.id = 'typing-indicator';
            
            const avatar = document.createElement('div');
            avatar.className = 'message-avatar';
            avatar.textContent = '🔥';
            
            const bubble = document.createElement('div');
            bubble.className = 'message-bubble';
            
            const indicator = document.createElement('div');
            indicator.className = 'typing-indicator';
            indicator.innerHTML = '<span></span><span></span><span></span>';
            
            bubble.appendChild(indicator);
            typingEl.appendChild(avatar);
            typingEl.appendChild(bubble);
            messagesDiv.appendChild(typingEl);
            messagesDiv.scrollTop = messagesDiv.scrollHeight;
        }
        
        function hideTyping() {
            const typing = document.getElementById('typing-indicator');
            if (typing) typing.remove();
        }
        
        // Send message
        async function sendMessage() {
            const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
            const sendBtn = document.getElementById('sendBtn');
            const message = input.value.trim();
            
            if (!message) return;
            
            // Add user message
            addMessage('user', message);
            
            // Clear input
            input.value = '';
            sendBtn.disabled = true;
            
            // Show typing
            showTyping();
            
            try {
                const response = await fetch('http://localhost:7792/think', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        message: message,
                        max_tokens: 512,
                        temperature: 0.9
                    })
                });
                
                const data = await response.json();
                hideTyping();
                
                // Add Ember's response
                addMessage('ember', data.response || 'I\'m thinking...');
                
            } catch (error) {
                hideTyping();
                addMessage('ember', '❌ Connection error. Is my brain running?');
            }
            
            sendBtn.disabled = false;
            input.focus();
        }
        
        function handleEnter(event) {
            if (event.key === 'Enter') {
                sendMessage();
            }
        }
        
        function quickCommand(cmd) {
            const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
            input.value = cmd + ' ';
            input.focus();
        }
        
        function toggleTheme() {
            // Theme toggle placeholder
            alert('Theme switching coming soon!');
        }
        
        // Initialize
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            initEmberCanvas();
            
            // Welcome message
            addMessage('ember', 'Hello! I\'m Ember. What would you like to explore today?');
            
            // Focus input
            document.getElementById('chatInput').focus();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

```
